properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q01 - Beaconing Detection - All Vendors
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == true
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| where not(ipv4_is_in_range(DestinationIP, "100.64.0.0/10"))
| where not(ipv4_is_in_range(DestinationIP, "169.254.0.0/16"))
| where not(ipv4_is_in_range(DestinationIP, "224.0.0.0/4"))
| summarize
    ConnectionCount  = count(),
    BytesSent        = sum(SentBytes),
    BytesReceived    = sum(ReceivedBytes),
    HourlyBuckets    = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)),
    ActiveMinutes    = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)),
    Ports            = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP, DestinationIP, DeviceVendor
| where ConnectionCount > 20 and HourlyBuckets >= 3
| extend BeaconScore = round(toreal(ConnectionCount) / toreal(HourlyBuckets), 1)
| where BeaconScore > 5
| order by BeaconScore desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Detects internal hosts making regular high-frequency connections to the same external IP across multiple hours. Beacon score = connections / hourly buckets.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q02 - Data Exfiltration - Anomalous Outbound Volume
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == true
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| summarize
    TotalBytesSent    = sum(SentBytes),
    TotalBytesRecv    = sum(ReceivedBytes),
    SessionCount      = count(),
    DestIPCount       = dcount(DestinationIP),
    DestIPs           = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    DestPorts         = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    DestHostNames     = make_set(DestinationHostName, 10),
    Users             = make_set(SourceUserName, 10),
    HourlyBuckets     = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)),
    DeviceVendors     = make_set(DeviceVendor)
  by SourceIP
| extend TotalMBSent = round(toreal(TotalBytesSent) / 1048576, 2)
| extend TotalMBRecv = round(toreal(TotalBytesRecv) / 1048576, 2)
| extend OutboundRatio = iff(isnull(TotalMBRecv) or TotalMBRecv <= 0,
                        0.0,
                        round(TotalMBSent / TotalMBRecv, 2))
| where TotalMBSent > 200
     and (DestIPCount >= 10 or OutboundRatio >= 5)
| order by TotalMBSent desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Detects internal hosts sending more than 500 MB to external destinations in 24 hours.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q03 - Threat Intelligence IP Correlation
properties.query:
let TI_IPs =
    ThreatIntelIndicators
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where isempty(ValidUntil) or ValidUntil > now()
    | where ObservableKey has "ip"
    | where ipv4_is_valid(ObservableValue)
    | summarize ThreatTypes = make_set(tostring(Tags), 10), ConfidenceScore = max(Confidence)
        by TI_IP = tolower(tostring(ObservableValue));
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")
| where isnotempty(DestinationIP) or isnotempty(SourceIP)
| extend CheckIP = tolower(tostring(iff(ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false,
|                                           DestinationIP, SourceIP)))
| join kind=inner TI_IPs on $left.CheckIP == $right.TI_IP
| summarize
    HitCount         = count(),
    InternalIPs      = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    DeviceVendors    = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated),
    ThreatTypes      = make_set(ThreatTypes),
    ConfidenceScore  = max(ConfidenceScore)
  by TI_IP
| order by HitCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Matches allowed firewall traffic source/dest IPs against active ThreatIntelIndicators entries.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q04 - Port Scanning - Single Source to Many Destinations
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| summarize
    UniqueDestPorts = dcount(DestinationPort),
    UniqueDestIPs   = dcount(DestinationIP),
    TotalAttempts   = count(),
    Actions         = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    Protocols       = make_set(Protocol, 5),
    FirstSeen       = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen        = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP, DeviceVendor
| where UniqueDestPorts > 30 or UniqueDestIPs > 50
| extend ScanType = case(
    UniqueDestPorts > 30 and UniqueDestIPs <= 10, "Vertical Scan (port sweep, single host)",
    UniqueDestIPs   > 50 and UniqueDestPorts <= 5, "Horizontal Scan (host sweep, single port)",
    "Combined Scan")
| order by UniqueDestPorts desc, UniqueDestIPs desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Detects port sweep or host sweep: source IP hitting more than 30 unique dest ports or 50 unique dest IPs in 1 hour.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q05 - High-Risk Country Inbound and Outbound Traffic
properties.query:
let HighRiskCountryCodes = dynamic([
    "CN", "RU", "KP", "IR", "SY", "CU", "BY", "VE", "AF", "LY"]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| extend
    DstCountry = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(DestinationIP).country_2),
    SrcCountry = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(SourceIP).country_2)
| where DstCountry in (HighRiskCountryCodes) or SrcCountry in (HighRiskCountryCodes)
| summarize
    ConnectionCount  = count(),
    BytesSent        = sum(SentBytes),
    InternalIPs      = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    ExternalIPs      = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
  by DstCountry, SrcCountry, DeviceVendor
| order by ConnectionCount desc

tags.name: description

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q06 - Lateral Movement - Internal Port Sweep
properties.query:
let LateralPorts = dynamic([
    "22", "23", "135", "139", "445", "3389", "5985", "5986",
    "1433", "1434", "3306", "5432", "1521", "8080"]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == true
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == true
| where SourceIP != DestinationIP
| extend DstPort = tostring(DestinationPort)
| where DstPort in (LateralPorts)
| summarize
    UniqueTargets   = dcount(DestinationIP),
    UniquePorts     = dcount(DstPort),
    TotalAttempts   = count(),
    AcceptedAttempts = countif(tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")),
    TargetIPs       = make_set(DestinationIP, 30),
    PortsUsed       = make_set(DstPort, 10),
    Users           = make_set(SourceUserName, 10),
    Actions         = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    FirstSeen       = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen        = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP, DeviceVendor
| where UniqueTargets > 5
| order by UniqueTargets desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Detects an internal IP connecting to many internal hosts on SMB, RDP, WinRM, SSH, or database ports.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q07 - Fortinet - IPS and Application Control Blocks
properties.query:
let utmCategories = dynamic(["utm", "antivirus", "webfilter", "app-ctrl", "ssl"]);
let utmSubtypes  = dynamic(["ips", "ips-packet", "av", "antibot", "file-block",
                            "appctrl", "webfilter", "fct-utm", "ips-anomaly",
                            "av-anomaly"]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where tolower(DeviceEventClassID) in (utmCategories)
    or tolower(Activity) in (utmSubtypes)
| extend IPSSignature = iff(isnotempty(DeviceCustomString1),
                            tostring(DeviceCustomString1),
                            extract(@"catdesc=([^ ]+)", 1, tostring(AdditionalExtensions)))
| extend IPSSignature = iff(isempty(IPSSignature), tostring(Activity), IPSSignature)
| summarize
    HitCount         = count(),
    BlockedCount     = countif(tolower(DeviceAction) == "blocked"),
    DetectedCount    = countif(tolower(DeviceAction) == "accept"),
    SourceIPs        = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    DestinationIPs   = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    Users            = make_set(SourceUserName, 10),
    RequestURLs      = make_set(RequestURL, 10),
    ProtocolsUsed    = make_set(Protocol, 5),
    SeverityValues   = make_set(LogSeverity, 5),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
  by IPSSignature
| extend Enforcement = iff(BlockedCount == 0, "Detected but NOT blocked",
                      iff(DetectedCount == 0, "Blocked", "Mixed"))
| order by HitCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Surfaces Fortinet IPS events grouped by signature name and source IP.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q12 - New and First-Seen External IP Allowed Through Firewall
properties.query:
let HistoricalIPs =
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(7d) .. ago(1d))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
    | where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
    | where tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")
    | where isnotempty(DestinationIP)
    | where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
    | summarize by DestinationIP;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| where isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| summarize
    ConnectionCount  = count(),
    SourceIPs        = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    BytesSent        = sum(SentBytes),
    Ports            = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    Protocols        = make_set(Protocol, 5),
    DeviceVendors    = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated)
  by DestinationIP
| where ConnectionCount > 5
| join kind=leftanti HistoricalIPs on DestinationIP
| order by ConnectionCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Identifies external destination IPs not seen in the prior 7 days that appeared in the last 24 hours.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q13 - Firewall Allow plus Azure AD Sign-In Correlation
properties.query:
let FirewallExternalIPs =
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
    | where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
    | where tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")
    | where isnotempty(DestinationIP)
    | where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
    | summarize
        FW_Connections = count(),
        FW_Sources     = make_set(SourceIP, 10),
        FW_BytesSent   = sum(SentBytes),
        FW_Vendors     = make_set(DeviceVendor)
      by ExternalIP = tolower(tostring(DestinationIP));
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where tostring(ResultType) == "0"
| where isnotempty(IPAddress)
| summarize
    AAD_SignInCount  = count(),
    AAD_Users        = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 20),
    AAD_AppNames     = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10),
    AAD_Countries    = make_set(Location, 5),
    AAD_RiskLevels   = make_set(RiskLevelDuringSignIn, 5)
  by IPAddress = tolower(tostring(IPAddress))
| join kind=inner FirewallExternalIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.ExternalIP
| project
    IPAddress,
    AAD_SignInCount,
    AAD_Users,
    AAD_Countries,
    AAD_RiskLevels,
    FW_Connections,
    FW_Sources,
    FW_BytesSent,
    FW_Vendors
| order by FW_Connections desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Correlates firewall-allowed external IPs against Azure AD successful sign-ins from the same IP.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q14 - CommonSecurityLog plus SecurityAlert IOC Correlation
properties.query:
let AlertIPs =
    SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where AlertSeverity in ("High", "Medium")
    | mv-expand todynamic(Entities)
    | where Entities.Type == "ip"
    | extend AlertIP = tolower(tostring(Entities.Address))
    | where isnotempty(AlertIP)
    | summarize
        AlertCount    = count(),
        AlertNames    = make_set(AlertName, 10),
        Severities    = make_set(AlertSeverity, 3),
        Products      = make_set(ProductName, 5)
      by AlertIP;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) or isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| extend CheckIP = tolower(tostring(iff(ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false,
|                                           DestinationIP, SourceIP)))
| summarize
    FW_HitCount     = count(),
    FW_Actions      = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    FW_InternalIPs  = make_set(SourceIP, 10),
    FW_Vendors      = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FW_FirstSeen    = min(TimeGenerated),
    FW_LastSeen     = max(TimeGenerated)
  by CheckIP
| join kind=inner AlertIPs on $left.CheckIP == $right.AlertIP
| project
    IOC_IP        = CheckIP,
    AlertCount,
    AlertNames,
    Severities,
    Products,
    FW_HitCount,
    FW_Actions,
    FW_InternalIPs,
    FW_Vendors,
    FW_FirstSeen,
    FW_LastSeen
| order by AlertCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Identifies firewall IPs that also appear in active Security Alerts from Defender or Sentinel.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q15 - CommonSecurityLog plus ThreatIntelligence Domain Match
properties.query:
let TI_Domains =
    ThreatIntelIndicators
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where isempty(ValidUntil) or ValidUntil > now()
    | where ObservableKey has "domain"
    | where isnotempty(ObservableValue)
    | summarize
        TI_ThreatTypes = make_set(Tags),
        TI_Confidence  = max(Confidence)
      by DomainName = tolower(tostring(ObservableValue));
let TI_URLs =
    ThreatIntelIndicators
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where isempty(ValidUntil) or ValidUntil > now()
    | where ObservableKey has "url"
    | where isnotempty(ObservableValue)
    | summarize
        TI_ThreatTypes = make_set(Tags),
        TI_Confidence  = max(Confidence)
      by Url = ObservableValue;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where isnotempty(DestinationHostName) or isnotempty(RequestURL)
| where tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")
| extend MatchKey = tolower(tostring(
    iff(isnotempty(DestinationHostName),
       DestinationHostName,
       extract(@"^https?://([^/:?#]+)", 1, tostring(RequestURL)))))
| where isnotempty(MatchKey)
| join kind=inner TI_Domains on $left.MatchKey == $right.DomainName
| summarize
    FW_HitCount    = count(),
    FW_Users       = make_set(SourceUserName, 10),
    FW_SourceIPs   = make_set(SourceIP, 10),
    FW_Actions     = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    FW_Vendors     = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    TI_ThreatTypes = make_set(TI_ThreatTypes),
    TI_Confidence  = max(TI_Confidence),
    FirstSeen      = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen       = max(TimeGenerated)
  by MatchKey
| order by FW_HitCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Joins firewall traffic against TI feed URLs and domains across all three vendors.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q17 - Fortinet - Repeated Auth Failures SSL-VPN and Admin
properties.query:
let authEventIDs = dynamic([
    "0101000002", "0101000012", "0102000002", "0101001013",
    "0101001057", "0101001058"]);
let authSubtypes = dynamic([
    "admin", "admin-login", "login", "loginfailed", "user", "auth",
    "sslvpn", "ssl-vpn", "vpn", "vpn-login", "authenticate"]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| extend EventID  = tolower(tostring(DeviceEventID))
| extend Subtype  = tolower(tostring(Activity))
| extend Category = tolower(tostring(DeviceEventClassID))
| extend Outcome  = tolower(tostring(EventOutcome))
| extend Action   = tolower(tostring(DeviceAction))
| where EventID in (authEventIDs)
    or Subtype in (authSubtypes)
    or (Category == "event" and isnotempty(SourceUserName))
| where Outcome has "fail"
    or Action in ("deny", "reject", "failed", "failure")
| summarize
    FailureCount     = count(),
    UniqueUsers      = dcount(SourceUserName),
    UserList         = make_set(SourceUserName, 20),
    Subtypes         = make_set(Activity, 10),
    EventIDs         = make_set(DeviceEventID, 10),
    DestinationIPs   = make_set(DestinationIP, 5),
    SourcePorts      = make_set(SourcePort, 5),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP
| where FailureCount > 5
| extend SprayPattern = UniqueUsers >= 3
| order by FailureCount desc

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q19 - Protocol Anomaly - HTTP and HTTPS on Non-Standard Ports

    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
  by DstPort, AppProto
| order by ConnectionCount desc

tags.name: description

        Manager          = any(Manager),

      by AccountUPN = tolower(tostring(AccountUPN));
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt FQ01 - FortiGate Log Coverage Census

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt FQ02 - FortiGate UTM and IPS Signature Leaderboard
properties.query:
let lookback = 24h;
let minHits = 1;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where tolower(DeviceEventClassID) in ("utm", "antivirus", "webfilter", "app-ctrl")
    or tolower(Activity) in ("ips", "ips-packet", "av", "antibot", "file-block",
                             "appctrl", "webfilter", "fct-utm", "ips-anomaly",
                             "av-anomaly")
| extend IPSSignature = iff(isnotempty(DeviceCustomString1),
                            tostring(DeviceCustomString1),
                            extract(@"catdesc=([^ ]+)", 1, tostring(AdditionalExtensions)))
| extend IPSSignature = iff(isempty(IPSSignature), tostring(Activity), IPSSignature)
| summarize
    HitCount        = count(),
    BlockedCount    = countif(tolower(DeviceAction) == "blocked"),
    DetectedCount   = countif(tolower(DeviceAction) == "accept"),
    SourceIPs       = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    DestHostNames   = make_set(DestinationHostName, 10),
    RequestURLs     = make_set(RequestURL, 10),
    Severities      = make_set(LogSeverity, 5),
    Apps            = make_set(ApplicationProtocol, 5),
    FirstSeen       = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen        = max(TimeGenerated)
  by IPSSignature
| where HitCount > minHits
| extend Enforcement = iff(BlockedCount == 0, "Detected but NOT blocked",
                      iff(DetectedCount == 0, "Blocked", "Mixed"))
| order by HitCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Top FortiGate UTM signatures by volume, with the sources that triggered them and the enforcement split. The signature name comes from DeviceCustomString1 where the connector populates it and is otherwise recovered from catdesc in AdditionalExtensions. A signature that is firing constantly is either a real campaign or a detection that is mis-tuned and has trained the analysts to ignore it.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt FQ08 - FortiGate DNS Telemetry and Tunneling Indicators
properties.query:
let lookback = 24h;
let minQueries = 500;
let longNameChars = 40;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where tolower(DeviceEventClassID) == "dns" or tolower(Activity) == "dns"
| extend QueriedName = tostring(DestinationHostName)
| extend QueriedName = iff(isempty(QueriedName),
                           extract(@"hostname=([^ ]+)", 1, tostring(AdditionalExtensions)),
                           QueriedName)
| extend ResponseCode = extract(@"rcode=([^ ]+)", 1, tostring(AdditionalExtensions))
| extend NameLength  = strlen(QueriedName)
| summarize
    QueryCount      = count(),
    UniqueNames     = dcount(QueriedName),
    MaxNameLength   = max(NameLength),
    LongNameCount   = countif(NameLength > longNameChars),
    NXDOMAINCount   = countif(ResponseCode has_any ("3", "NXDOMAIN")),
    SourceIPs       = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    SampleNames     = make_set(QueriedName, 10),
    FirstSeen       = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen        = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP
| where QueryCount > minQueries
| extend NXDOMAINRatio = iff(QueryCount > 0, round(100.0 * toreal(NXDOMAINCount) / toreal(QueryCount), 1), 0.0)
| extend LongNameRatio = iff(QueryCount > 0, round(100.0 * toreal(LongNameCount) / toreal(QueryCount), 1), 0.0)
| order by QueryCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: FortiGate DNS query telemetry: volume per internal host, the share of responses that did not resolve, and the length of the queried name. Long names with a high NXDOMAIN rate are the classic DNS tunnelling shape, where data is encoded into subdomains to smuggle it out. FortiGate only carries the queried name and the response code, so the entropy signal here is length and repetition, not character distribution.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt FQ09 - FortiGate Policy Hit Analysis

| extend PolicyId = extract(@"policyid=([^ ]+)", 1, tostring(AdditionalExtensions))
| extend Action   = tolower(tostring(DeviceAction))
| summarize
    TotalEvents   = count(),
    AcceptedCount = countif(Action in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")),
    DeniedCount   = countif(Action in ("deny", "drop", "blocked", "reject")),
    SourceIPs     = dcount(SourceIP),
    DestIPs       = dcount(DestinationIP),
    Apps          = make_set(ApplicationProtocol, 5),
    FirstSeen     = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen      = max(TimeGenerated)
  by PolicyId
| order by TotalEvents desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Which FortiGate policies are carrying traffic, how much, and which are carrying none. An unused policy is attack surface that is maintained but never exercised, and a policy carrying an unexpected volume of denied traffic is often the policy an attacker is testing. The policy id is read from the policyid key in AdditionalExtensions.

properties.displayName: Firewall Beaconing Detection - Regular Outbound Connections
properties.description: Detects internal hosts making regular, high-frequency connections to the same external IP across at least three hourly buckets - the hallmark of C2 beaconing. Queries Fortinet, Palo Alto and Zscaler CEF logs for PERMITTED sessions only, then scores the pattern as connections per hour. The permitted-traffic filter is a positive allow-list. FortiGate reports act=blocked for UTM blocks and Palo Alto and Zscaler use their own action verbs, so the previous deny-list was counting blocked traffic as permitted and inflating the score. The schedule runs every 6 hours over a 6 hour window, so the same sessions do not re-alert on every evaluation. MITRE ATT&CK: T1071 (Application Layer Protocol), T1571 (Non-Standard Port)
properties.query:
let lookback = 6h;
let minConnections = 20;
let minHourlyBuckets = 3;
let minBeaconScore = 5.0;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
// Positive allow-list. FortiGate emits act=blocked for UTM blocks and
// Palo Alto / Zscaler use their own action verbs, so the previous
// deny-list silently counted blocked traffic as permitted.
| where tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == true
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| where not(ipv4_is_in_range(DestinationIP, "100.64.0.0/10"))
| where not(ipv4_is_in_range(DestinationIP, "169.254.0.0/16"))
| where not(ipv4_is_in_range(DestinationIP, "224.0.0.0/4"))
| summarize
    ConnectionCount  = count(),
    BytesSent        = sum(SentBytes),
    BytesReceived    = sum(ReceivedBytes),
    HourlyBuckets    = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)),
    ActiveMinutes    = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)),
    DestPorts        = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    DestHostNames    = make_set(DestinationHostName, 10),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP, DestinationIP, DeviceVendor
| where ConnectionCount > minConnections and HourlyBuckets >= minHourlyBuckets
| extend BeaconScore = round(toreal(ConnectionCount) / toreal(HourlyBuckets), 1)
| extend BytesPerSession = round(toreal(BytesSent) / toreal(ConnectionCount), 1)
| where BeaconScore > minBeaconScore
| order by BeaconScore desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Internal host {{SourceIP}} made {{ConnectionCount}} connections to external IP {{DestinationIP}} with a regular interval pattern (beacon score: {{BeaconScore}}).

properties.displayName: Firewall Anomalous Outbound Data Volume - Exfiltration Risk
properties.description: Detects internal hosts sending large volumes of data to external destinations via Fortinet, Palo Alto or Zscaler. Raw volume alone is a weak signal - a backup job or a large software download looks identical - so the rule now also requires either fan-out to many distinct external destinations, or a strongly skewed outbound to inbound byte ratio, which is what staged exfiltration actually looks like. Only permitted sessions are counted. FortiGate reports act=blocked for UTM blocks, and the previous deny-list counted those as permitted. The schedule runs once a day over a 24 hour window, so the same traffic does not re-alert every hour. MITRE ATT&CK: T1048 (Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol), T1041 (Exfiltration Over C2 Channel)
properties.query:
let lookback = 1d;
let minMB = 200.0;
let minDestIPs = 10;
let minOutboundRatio = 5.0;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
// Positive allow-list. FortiGate emits act=blocked for UTM blocks and
// Palo Alto / Zscaler use their own action verbs, so the previous
// deny-list silently counted blocked traffic as permitted.
| where tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == true
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| where not(ipv4_is_in_range(DestinationIP, "100.64.0.0/10"))
| summarize
    TotalBytesSent    = sum(SentBytes),
    TotalBytesRecv    = sum(ReceivedBytes),
    SessionCount      = count(),
    DestIPCount       = dcount(DestinationIP),
    DestIPs           = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    DestPorts         = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    DestHostNames     = make_set(DestinationHostName, 10),
    Users             = make_set(SourceUserName, 10),
    HourlyBuckets     = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)),
    DeviceVendors     = make_set(DeviceVendor)
  by SourceIP
| extend TotalMBSent = round(toreal(TotalBytesSent) / 1048576, 2)
| extend TotalMBRecv = round(toreal(TotalBytesRecv) / 1048576, 2)
| extend OutboundRatio = iff(isnull(TotalMBRecv) or TotalMBRecv <= 0,
                        0.0,
                        round(TotalMBSent / TotalMBRecv, 2))
| where TotalMBSent > minMB
     and (DestIPCount >= minDestIPs or OutboundRatio >= minOutboundRatio)
| order by TotalMBSent desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Host {{SourceIP}} transmitted {{TotalMBSent}} MB to external destinations across {{SessionCount}} sessions. Possible data exfiltration activity.

properties.displayName: Firewall Traffic to Threat Intelligence Flagged IP
properties.description: Correlates permitted firewall traffic (Fortinet, Palo Alto, Zscaler) against active threat intelligence indicators. Any permitted connection to a TI-flagged IP is a high-confidence indicator of compromise, C2 communication, or active exploitation. Both sides of the join are lower-cased before comparison, because the TI feed and the firewall log disagree on capitalisation often enough to silently drop matches. The traffic window is now one hour to match the schedule, so a TI match alerts once when it is first seen rather than re-firing every fifteen minutes. MITRE ATT&CK: T1071 (Application Layer Protocol), T1078 (Valid Accounts)
properties.query:
let TI_IPs =
    ThreatIntelIndicators
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where isempty(ValidUntil) or ValidUntil > now()
    | where ObservableKey has "ip"
    | where ipv4_is_valid(ObservableValue)
    | summarize
        ThreatTypes     = make_set(tostring(Tags), 10),
        ConfidenceScore = max(Confidence),
        IndicatorIds    = make_set(tostring(Id), 5)
      by TI_IP = tolower(tostring(ObservableValue));
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
// Positive allow-list. FortiGate emits act=blocked for UTM blocks and
// Palo Alto / Zscaler use their own action verbs, so the previous
// deny-list silently counted blocked traffic as permitted.
| where tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")
| where isnotempty(DestinationIP) or isnotempty(SourceIP)
| extend CheckIP = tolower(tostring(iff(ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false,
                                                DestinationIP, SourceIP)))
| join kind=inner TI_IPs on $left.CheckIP == $right.TI_IP
| summarize
    HitCount         = count(),
    InternalIPs      = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    RepresentativeIP = any(SourceIP),
    DestIPs          = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    DeviceVendors    = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated),
    ThreatTypes      = make_set(ThreatTypes, 10),
    ConfidenceScore  = max(ConfidenceScore),
    IndicatorIds     = make_set(IndicatorIds, 5)
  by TI_IP
| order by HitCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: TI Match - Firewall Allowed Traffic to {{TI_IP}}
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: TI-flagged IP {{TI_IP}} (confidence: {{ConfidenceScore}}) was seen in {{HitCount}} allowed firewall events. Possible C2 communication or active IOC.

properties.displayName: Firewall Port Scan Detection - Vertical and Horizontal Sweeps
properties.description: Detects network reconnaissance by identifying source IPs that contact more than 30 unique destination ports (vertical sweep) or more than 50 unique destination IPs (horizontal sweep) within one hour. Both patterns indicate active network mapping or exploitation preparation. The rule now separates sweeps that policy permitted from sweeps the firewall blocked. A FortiGate that denies the sweep is working; a sweep that succeeds is the finding that matters, and ScanOutcome surfaces the difference at a glance. MITRE ATT&CK: T1046 (Network Service Discovery)
properties.query:
let lookback = 1h;
let minPorts = 30;
let minIPs = 50;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| summarize
    UniqueDestPorts  = dcount(DestinationPort),
    UniqueDestIPs    = dcount(DestinationIP),
    TotalAttempts    = count(),
    AcceptedAttempts = countif(tolower(DeviceAction) in ("accept", "allowed", "allow")),
    DeniedAttempts   = countif(tolower(DeviceAction) in ("deny", "drop", "blocked", "reject")),
    Actions          = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    Protocols        = make_set(Protocol, 5),
    TargetIPs        = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP, DeviceVendor
| where UniqueDestPorts > minPorts or UniqueDestIPs > minIPs
| extend ScanType = case(
    UniqueDestPorts > minPorts and UniqueDestIPs <= 10, "Vertical Scan (port sweep)",
    UniqueDestIPs   > minIPs   and UniqueDestPorts <= 5,  "Horizontal Scan (host sweep)",
    "Combined Scan")
// A sweep that was PERMITTED matters far more than one the firewall blocked.
| extend ScanOutcome = iff(AcceptedAttempts > 0,
                         "Partially or fully permitted",
                         "Blocked")
| order by UniqueDestPorts desc, UniqueDestIPs desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Source {{SourceIP}} targeted {{UniqueDestIPs}} IPs across {{UniqueDestPorts}} unique ports. Possible network reconnaissance activity.

| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))

properties.displayName: Fortinet FortiGate - UTM, IPS and Malware Events by Source
properties.description: Detects FortiGate UTM events raised by the gateway - IPS signatures, antivirus, anti-bot, file blocking and application control - grouped by the source that triggered them. Repeated hits on the same source indicate an automated exploitation attempt, a drive-by infection chain, or a compromised internal host probing adjacent systems. Two FortiGate specifics drive the rule. DeviceAction is "blocked" when the gateway enforced the policy and "accept" when it only detected, so the rule reports the enforcement split separately - a "detected but not blocked" hit is the one that needs attention first, because it means the control exists and did not fire. The IPS signature name is read from DeviceCustomString1 when the connector populates it and is otherwise recovered from the catdesc key inside AdditionalExtensions; confirm which of the two your connector populates, because the field lands in different places depending on the ingestion path. BroadExploitation marks a source that triggered several different signatures in the same window, which is the difference between one noisy site and a sweep. MITRE ATT&CK: T1190 (Exploit Public-Facing Application), T1203 (Exploitation for Client Execution), T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer)
properties.query:
let lookback = 1h;
let minHits = 3;
let minDistinctSignatures = 5;
// FortiGate log category, carried in DeviceEventClassID on some ingestion
// paths and in Activity on others, so both are tested.
let utmCategories = dynamic(["utm", "app-ctrl", "antivirus", "webfilter", "ssl"]);
let utmSubtypes  = dynamic(["ips", "ips-packet", "av", "antibot", "file-block",
                            "appctrl", "webfilter", "fct-utm", "ips-anomaly",
                            "av-anomaly"]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where tolower(DeviceEventClassID) in (utmCategories)
    or tolower(Activity) in (utmSubtypes)
| extend IPSSignature = iff(isnotempty(DeviceCustomString1),
                            tostring(DeviceCustomString1),
                            extract(@"catdesc=([^ ]+)", 1, tostring(AdditionalExtensions)))
| extend IPSSignature = iff(isempty(IPSSignature), tostring(Activity), IPSSignature)
| where isnotempty(SourceIP)
| summarize
    HitCount             = count(),
    BlockedCount         = countif(tolower(DeviceAction) == "blocked"),
    DetectedOnlyCount    = countif(tolower(DeviceAction) == "accept"),
    DistinctSignatures   = dcount(IPSSignature),
    Signatures           = make_set(IPSSignature, 20),
    DestinationIPs       = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    Users                = make_set(SourceUserName, 10),
    RequestURLs          = make_set(RequestURL, 10),
    DestHostNames        = make_set(DestinationHostName, 10),
    Severities           = make_set(LogSeverity, 5),
    Apps                 = make_set(ApplicationProtocol, 5),
    RepresentativeDestIP = any(DestinationIP),
    FirstSeen            = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen             = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP
| where HitCount > minHits
| extend Enforcement = iff(BlockedCount == 0,
                           "Detected but NOT blocked",
                           iff(DetectedOnlyCount == 0, "Blocked", "Mixed"))
| extend BroadExploitation = DistinctSignatures >= minDistinctSignatures
| order by HitCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Source {{SourceIP}} triggered {{HitCount}} FortiGate UTM events across {{DistinctSignatures}} distinct signatures ({{BlockedCount}} blocked). Signatures: {{Signatures}}. If Enforcement is 'Detected but NOT blocked' the control did not fire.

properties.description: Surfaces Palo Alto Networks threat log entries for malware, spyware, wildfire, vulnerability and virus events that triggered more than 5 times in 24 hours. These indicate active detection by the firewall's content inspection engine, and repeated threat events from one source often mean malware activity or active C2 traffic. Entity mappings were previously empty, so these alerts could never populate the investigation graph or drive incident grouping. MITRE ATT&CK: T1190 (Exploit Public-Facing Application), T1071 (Application Layer Protocol)
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("SourceIP",""))))
| where not(ExcludeAllowlistedIPs_Firewall(tostring(column_ifexists("DestinationIP",""))))
| where DeviceVendor == "Palo Alto Networks"
| where DeviceEventClassID has_any ("THREAT", "threat", "WILDFIRE-VIRUS", "SPYWARE", "VULNERABILITY")
    or Activity has_any ("threat", "wildfire", "spyware", "vulnerability", "virus")
| summarize

    RepresentativeSourceIP = any(SourceIP),

    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
